what_this_is: the regular pattern rule measured on pictures that are not gratings, which is what the grating conformance suite cannot cover. Ground truth is what eval/pattern_text_frames.py drew.
not_a_wcag_measurement: WCAG 2.2 SC 2.3.1 does not cover regular patterns, so no number here is a WCAG number and none of it may be described as WCAG conformance.
area_limit_note: the stationary limit, because every picture here is a still. The shipped analyzer is stricter on a held still: an uncertain motion class takes the changing limit.

spec_numbers.status: ITU-R BT.1702-3 Attachment 1 to Annex 1 is informative and says its criteria are used by some administrations. WCAG 2.2 SC 2.3.1 does not cover regular patterns at all, so nothing in this suite is a WCAG measurement.

how_the_shipped_peak_was_chosen: the largest peak at which recall does not fall. The rule was fixed before the sweep was read, because a threshold picked to make one page pass is not a measurement. Recall is flat from 0 up to the chosen value and drops above it.
